key.name: tiles
key.summary: Tiles in the control centre, in order
key.description: Tile ids: wifi, bluetooth, mobile-data, flashlight, dnd, rotation-lock, airplane, location, battery-saver, night-light, hotspot, screen-record, dark-theme, silent, screenshot, bedtime, stay-awake, greyscale, scan-qr. Tiles not listed are in the editor's tray. Tiles whose backend is missing are not shown.
